caption:
Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build an AI setter for your Manychat flow, for free. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: why a "Comment GUIDE" flow can get 400 comments and 0 sales, and what happens to the replies.

1. Manychat does its job: everyone who comments GUIDE gets the guide in their DMs.

2. Then a lead replies with a real question, like "is this guide for beginners?". A keyword flow answers the keyword, not the question, so it can send the same guide again.

3. Everyone else who asked something sits in the inbox, collecting dust.

4. Setty is the AI setter I built for coaches: you keep your Manychat flow and add two actions, with no code. He answers the real question in your voice, one question at a time, and only the serious ones get your calendar.

The catch: Setty doesn't replace Manychat, so you need a Manychat account. Building and testing are free with no card, then going live starts a 14-day trial at $119/month per live setter.
